newsitem.title: USA: Yields rise on Bond Buyer's weekly indices.
newsitem.headline: Yields rise on Bond Buyer's weekly indices.

text.p: Yields on the Bond Buyer municipal bond indices rose this week.
The yield on the 20-bond index of general obligation bonds calculated Thursday, Dec 12, was 5.66 percent, up nine basis points from last week.
The yield on the 11-bond index of GO bonds was 5.56 percent, also up nine basis points from last week.
The yield on the 30-year revenue bond index was 5.93 percent, 10 basis points higher than last week.
